purpose: Tester-selected holdout seeds frozen by GC-004 before any calibration run or candidate tuning exists.

freezeEvidence.preparationRecord: GC-004 preparation record, kept outside this repository
freezeEvidence.note: No calibration run, candidate graph result or tuning report existed when these seeds were recorded. Only specification inputs were read.

derivation.rule: SHA-256('global-cart-v1/holdout/<index>'), take the first four bytes big-endian as uint32
constraints: value must be a non-zero uint32
value must not duplicate a named training or public-adversarial seed
value must not duplicate an earlier holdout
derivation.reproduce: for index in 1..6 compute the digest and read uint32 BE at offset 0; skip and continue only on a constraint collision

policy: These seeds are not training seeds and must not be used by any calibration, tuning or candidate-selection run.
They may be used only by independent verification cards (GC-019/GC-020 and later) after candidate code is frozen.
Changing a seed requires a new holdout fixture revision recorded before the next candidate freeze.
A passing result on training seeds does not consume or reveal these holdouts.
